actions.description: Most recently modified notes: title and modification time.
script: set noteNames to name of every note
set noteDates to modification date of every note
set n to count of noteNames
repeat with i from 1 to n
set out to out & (item i of noteNames) & fsep & ((item i of noteDates) as «class isot» as string) & rsep

actions.description: Notes whose title contains the query text.
script: set hits to (every note whose name contains "{{query}}")
set out to out & (name of nt) & fsep & ((modification date of nt) as «class isot» as string) & rsep

actions.description: Plain-text body of the first note whose title contains the given text.
script: set hits to (every note whose name contains "{{title}}")
if (count of hits) is 0 then return ""
return plaintext of item 1 of hits
